item.batoru.gauntlet.invalid_owner: You are not the owner of this gauntlet!
lore.batoru.gauntlet: An item that can store spell cards and allows spell casting.
lore.batoru.projectile_spell_card: A common card that can be equipped in a Student Gauntlet. When cast, shoots an energy ball.
lore.batoru.starfall_spell_card: An epic card that can be equipped in a Student Gauntlet. When cast, launches the player upward and slams them into the ground.
lore.batoru.tech_sword: A high-tech sword built with spatial displacement technology. Marks a location, then teleports the wielder to it.
lore.batoru.street_axe: A mysterious axe. From da streets!
